_comment: Workshop flyer spec for project.py on the event flyer templates (named fields). One spec serves every size: each artifact in project.json picks the template profile (event-flyer, event-flyer-tabloid, event-flyer-17x22). {{facts.x}} comes from project.json; a fact that is a list (agenda, workflow) replaces the whole value. new_deck.py makes the QR code from registration_qr at the template's slot size and prints the clean URL in registration_url; project.py then verifies it in the exported PDF.
title: {{facts.event_title_plain}}
author: Advanced Telerobotics Research Lab

slides.notes: Event facts come from project.json. Programming experience required; robotics experience optional. The QR code and the printed address both point to the registration URL in project.json. The tool icons are ATR stand-ins: replace them with the vendors' official product icons (project.py replace-asset tool-claude-code <file>). The Kent State wordmark in the template is a working copy: replace it with the official file before sharing.
